module: World Editor terrain editor ('Terrain Tools' edit mode, terrainToolsEditMode). It handles the sculpting, material painting and terraforming brushes (via extensions/editor/terraformTool), the choice of the active TerrainBlock, the level's terrain material library (art/terrain/main.materials.json) as 'proxies', the terrain import/export window (heightmap, hole map, texture maps, meshes, presets) and saving the terrain and materials before the level is saved. A modder mostly uses it to get the TerrainBlock/TerrainEditor object (getTerrainBlock, getTerrainEditor), mark the terrain as modified (setTerrainDirty) or manipulate painted materials.
usage:
local te = extensions.editor_terrainEditor
local tb = te.getTerrainBlock()
if tb then
  tb:setHeight(10, 10, 5.0)
  tb:updateGrid(vec3(10,10), vec3(10,10))
  te.setTerrainDirty()
end
notes: Material paths are /art/terrain/main.materials.json (or /art/terrains/... for the old format, detected by checkForTerrainMaterialFileFormat); they are read relative to var.levelPath.

Brush: size 1 to 256 (changeBrushSize), pressure/softness/height as a percentage in the terrainEditor.general.* preferences; terraforming: terrainEditor.terraform.* preferences (DOI, margin, falloff, roughness, scale).
Paint material indices on the Lua side are 1-based (k) whereas the C++ TerrainBlock/terrainEditor expects k-1.
Emitted hooks (extensions.hook) around the terrain save: onEditorBeforeSaveTerrain then onEditorAfterSaveTerrain, for tools with a live paint overlay.
Automatic migration: if a material has no groundmodelName, it is filled from the uppercase internalName (or 'ASPHALT' for a new material), with a warning and a dirty mark.
getTerrainBlock() returns nil if there is no active TerrainBlock (e.g. smallgrid level).

getTerrainBlock.desc: Returns the active TerrainBlock object (looked up by its id) or nil if there is none.

getTerrainEditor.desc: Returns the TerrainEditor (C++) object used for world/grid conversions, brushes and actions.

setActiveTerrainBlock.desc: Sets the TerrainBlock the tools work on (until the user chooses another): attaches it to the TerrainEditor, resets the selected paint material and selects the first one. No effect if the id is not found.

updateEditorTerrainBlocks.desc: Rescans the level's TerrainBlocks, detaches the old ones and attaches all the new ones to the TerrainEditor, then reactivates the preferred block (or the active one, or the first); clears the state if there are none left.

preferredId.desc: Id of the block to activate first.

updateTerrainBlockProxies.desc: Rebuilds the list of the level's TerrainBlocks (proxies {selected, id} by name) and the sorted list of names for the combo.

getTerrainBlockProxies.desc: Table of TerrainBlock proxies keyed by object name.

setTerrainDirty.desc: Marks the terrain as modified (editor.setDirty) and shows the 'unsaved terrain changes' notification. The terrain will be saved when the level is saved. To be called after any direct modification of the heightmap.

setMaterialsDirty.desc: Marks the terrain materials as modified (editor.setDirty + notification); they will be saved with the level.

saveTerrainAndMaterials.desc: Saves the materials then the terrain file (.ter) of the active TerrainBlock, clears the notifications and displays 'Saved TerrainBlock'.

changeBrushSize.desc: Increases (value == 1) or decreases (value == 0) the brush size by `step`, clamped to 1-256, and applies it to the TerrainEditor. Any other value of value changes nothing.

beginChangeBrushSizeWithKeys.desc: Enables auto-repeat of the brush size change with the [ and ] keys.

direction.desc: Direction of the change (changeBrushSize convention: 1 enlarge, 0 reduce, inferred from code)

endChangeBrushSizeWithKeys.desc: Stops the auto-repeat of the brush size change.

setupVars.desc: See above: recomputes the UI variables.

getVars.desc: Returns the internal var table (UI state, levelPath, current brush...).

getTerrainFolder.desc: Folder of the level's terrain materials: '/art/terrain/' or the old '/art/terrains/'.

getMatFilePath.desc: Path (relative to the level) of the terrain materials file, normally '/art/terrain/main.materials.json'.

checkForTerrainMaterialFileFormat.desc: Detects the location of the materials file (art/terrain or old art/terrains) and flags the obsolete format (errors.deprecated_material_file).

getErrors.desc: Table of detected format errors/warnings (key -> true).

fixedFileFormat.desc: Clears the 'deprecated_material_file' error (to be called once the materials file has been upgraded).

updateMaterialLibrary.desc: Rereads the level's JSON materials file and rebuilds the library (materialsInJson). (A TODO in the code says this should migrate to terrainMaterialsEditor.lua.)

getMaterialsInJson.desc: Level material library read from the JSON.

returns.desc: Materials keyed by id/persistentId, with internalName, etc.

deleteMaterialInJson.desc: Removes from the in-memory library the material with the given internalName (does not modify the file).

getUniqueMtlName.desc: Returns a material name absent from the library: initialName, then initialName0, initialName1...

getMtlIdByName.desc: Looks up an import material by name (exact, then case-insensitive). Returns its 0-based index, its name and whether it was found; otherwise 0 and the first material with found=false; (0, 'unknown', false) if there are none.

createMaterialProxy.desc: Builds a Lua proxy of a terrain material (diffuse/normal/detail/macro maps, sizes, strengths, distances, side projection, parallaxScale, groundmodelName, uniqueID = name-persistentId). Calls fixGroundmodelName; if dirty is true, also marks the terrain as modified.

isNew.desc: true if the material was newly created

copyMaterialProxyWithInputs.desc: Deep copy of a material proxy, recreating the imgui input widgets (name, size, strengths...). Fills groundmodelName from the uppercase internalName if it is empty.

fixGroundmodelName.desc: Migration: the groundmodel used to be stored in the internalName; now a dedicated groundmodel field exists. If this field is empty, it is filled from the uppercase internalName (or 'ASPHALT' for a new material), the material is marked dirty and a warning is logged.

updatePaintMaterialProxies.desc: Rebuilds the paint material proxies of the active TerrainBlock (names, indices, inTerrainBlock), warns if the count does not match and reselects the previous material.

getPaintMaterialProxies.desc: List of the paint material proxies of the active TerrainBlock.

getSelectedPaintMaterialProxy.desc: Proxy of the selected paint material (or nil).

selectPaintMaterial.desc: Selects a paint material and sets the TerrainEditor paint index (index - 1).

getTerrainBlockMaterialIndex.desc: Index (1-based) of the paint material with this internalName, or -1 if it is not in the block.

updateMap.desc: Assigns a texture path to a map of a proxy ('diffuse', 'macro', 'detail', 'normal') or to the importer/exporter fields ('heightMap', 'holeMap', 'textureMap', 'mesh', or table {meshIndex=...}).

removeMap.desc: Clears a map of a proxy (updateMap with an empty path). A TODO in the code questions the origin of mtlProxy.

dragDropTarget.desc: imgui drag-and-drop target for an asset (ASSETDRAGDROP payload of 2048 bytes): calls updateMap with the dropped path. To be called right after an imgui widget.

onEditorGui.desc: Render hook: draws the import dialog, the export dialog, the paint window, the softness curve and the terrain toolbar.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the windows (terrainPainter, import, export, softness curve, autoPaint modal) and the 'Terrain Tools' edit mode, then calls initialize().

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is deactivated; does nothing in this version.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the mission: clears the in-memory material library.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Hook called before the level is saved: saves the modified terrain materials then the terrain file (emitting onEditorBeforeSaveTerrain / onEditorAfterSaveTerrain) if changes are pending.

onEditorObjectAdded.desc: Hook called when an object is added in the editor: if it is a TerrainBlock, rescans the blocks (updateEditorTerrainBlocks).

onEditorDeleteSelection.desc: Hook called before the selection is deleted: detaches the selected TerrainBlocks from the TerrainEditor and clears the state if it was the active block, to avoid crashes.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes: applies terrainEditor.general.* (size, pressure, softness, height, slopes, soft selection filter) and terrainEditor.terraform.* (DOI, margin, falloff, roughness, scale) to the brush/terraformer.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Preference registration hook: creates the terrainEditor category (general, import, terrainMaterialLibrary, terraform) with their default values and bounds.
